name: loomground-deontic
description: Transcribe a natural-language norm into a verified deontic formula: split it into modality (O/P/F), bearer, and action; classify the Hohfeldian incident; resolve a 'right' as a claim or a liberty; validate with a bundled stdlib engine; and flag candidate conflicts. Transcribes and flags, never infers or resolves.
